manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian exiled by Glorious Protector
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glorious Protector and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Felidar Guardian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Glorious Protector to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Glorious Protector and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Glorious Protector and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
